Extract expected category statistics from an S7 model, representation, or fit object

Source: R/S7-generics.R, R/S7-stanfit-posterior.R, R/S7-stanfit-methods.R
get_expected_category_statistic.Rd

Computes the expected value of category parameters such as mean vectors (\(\mu\)) or covariance/scatter matrices (\(\Sigma\) / \(S\)) under the model's distribution.

Usage

get_expected_category_statistic(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  statistic = c("mu", "Sigma"),
  ...
)

get_marginal_category_statistic(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  statistic = c("mu", "Sigma"),
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_expected_category_statistic(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  statistic = c("mu", "Sigma"),
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_StanfitPosterior>
get_marginal_category_statistic(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  statistic = c("mu", "Sigma"),
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
get_expected_category_statistic(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  statistic = c("mu", "Sigma"),
  ...
)

## S7 method for class <MVBU_Stanfit>
get_marginal_category_statistic(
  x,
  categories = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  statistic = c("mu", "Sigma"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An S7 object (cognitive model, category representation, template, or stanfit).

categories

Optional character vector of category names. Default: NULL (all categories).

groups

Optional character vector of group names. Default: NULL (all groups).

statistic

Character scalar indicating the statistic to extract: "mu" (expected mean), "Sigma" or "sigma" (expected covariance), "m", "S", "kappa", or "nu".

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

Value

A numeric vector, matrix, or list of expected values.

See also

get_expected_mu, get_expected_sigma, get_marginal_category_statistic, get_parameters

Examples

mod <- example_mvg_ideal_observer(n_cues = 2)
get_expected_category_statistic(mod, statistic = "mu")
